name: lifting-core
description: Pure strength-training plans as FHIR R4 resources: a PlanDefinition of workouts and planned exercises with their progression rule, an exercise ServiceRequest at one load, the set Observations logged against it grouped into sessions, the increment / hold / deload decision and the StrongLifts 5x5 template — each a schema narrowing the decoded fhir-r4 type, with a make and getters. No DOM, no platform imports.
